readme:
# CutShort Job Scraper: Tech Jobs and Salaries in India

Get tech job listings from [CutShort](https://cutshort.io), the Indian hiring marketplace for software, data, product and design roles, as clean dataset rows. Search by skill, narrow by city, and get the newest jobs first. Each row has the title, company, location, salary range in INR, experience, skills, remote type and posting date. Turn on job details to add the full description and company facts.

## What you can do with it

- Build a list of companies that hire tech people in India, by skill and city, for recruiting, sales or market research.
- Watch the Indian tech job market over time: run it on a schedule and track new jobs, salaries and skills in demand.
- Feed a job board or an alert service with fresh CutShort jobs.
- Compare salary ranges and experience levels per skill and city.

## Input

All fields are optional. An empty input (`{}`) runs the example below: the 10 newest `python` jobs.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `searchQueries` | string[] | Skills or role keywords such as `python`, `golang`, `reactjs` or `data engineering`. One search each. Queries map to CutShort skill hubs, and close words are mapped to the nearest hub |
| `location` | string[] | Cities such as Bangalore, Pune or Remote. Empty = all of India |
| `startUrls` | string[] | CutShort skill pages (`https://cutshort.io/jobs/golang-jobs-in-pune`) or single job pages |
| `sortBy` | string | `newest` (default) or `site_order` (the order CutShort shows) |
| `postedWithinDays` | integer | Only jobs posted in the last N days. 0 = no filter |
| `maxResults` | integer | Cap across all searches. 0 = no cap (default 100) |
| `maxResultsPerQuery` | integer | Cap per keyword or start URL. Follows `maxResults` when you only set that |
| `includeJobDetails` | boolean | Open every job page for the full description and company facts (default false) |

Example input:

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["python"],
  "maxResults": 10
}
```

Example, Go jobs in Pune and Bangalore from the last two weeks, with full descriptions:

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["golang"],
  "location": ["Pune", "Bangalore"],
  "postedWithinDays": 14,
  "maxResults": 60,
  "includeJobDetails": true
}
```

How the search works:

- CutShort has no free-text search on its public pages. Jobs are grouped into about 3,800 skill pages. Each keyword is matched to the closest skill page, for example `go` becomes Golang and `machine learning` becomes Machine Learning (ML). A keyword with no skill page is skipped, and the run status names it.
- A skill page lists at most 50 jobs. When you ask for more and no city is set, the Actor also reads the skill's city pages and removes duplicates.
- CutShort has no public sort option. `newest` sorts the jobs it finds by posting date. CutShort renews the posting date when an employer re-activates a job, so a renewed job counts as new.
- Some jobs are posted by recruiting agencies for an anonymous client. They have `hiring_for_client: true` and show the agency as the company.

## Output

One row per job. Jobs found by several searches are returned once, and duplicates are removed before anything is charged.

| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| `id` | CutShort job id. |
| `title` | Job title. |
| `job_url` | Public job page URL on CutShort (unique per job). |
| `source_url` | Alias of job_url (fleet-standard). |
| `source_platform` | Always cutshort. |
| `company_name` | Hiring company or recruiting agency name. |
| `company_profile_url` | Company page on CutShort. |
| `company_logo_url` | Company logo URL (null when the company has no logo). |
| `company_website` | Company website. Only with includeJobDetails. |
| `company_size` | Company size range. Only with includeJobDetails. |
| `company_type` | Company type, for example Product or Services. Only with includeJobDetails. |
| `recruiter_name` | Name of the recruiter who posted the job, shown on the search card. The detail page value wins with includeJobDetails. |
| `recruiter_picture_url` | Recruiter profile picture URL, often a generic letter icon. |
| `company_stage` | Funding stage, for example Bootstrapped. Filled from the search card when it shows one, the detail page value wins with includeJobDetails. |
| `company_founded` | Founding year. Only with includeJobDetails. |
| `company_description` | Company description as Markdown. Only with includeJobDetails. |
| `hiring_for_client` | True when an agency posts the job for an anonymous client company. |
| `location` | Location text as shown on CutShort. Several cities are comma separated. |
| `locations` | Each location as listed by CutShort. |
| `city` | First location without the bracketed alias. |
| `postal_code` | Postal code from the job structured data. Only with includeJobDetails. |
| `country` | Two-letter country code from the job structured data. Only with includeJobDetails. |
| `work_type` | onsite, hybrid (remote possible) or remote. |
| `is_remote` | True when the job is remote only. |
| `employment_type` | Full time, Internship or Temporary (comma separated when several). |
| `salary_min` | Lower salary bound. Null when the employer hides the salary. |
| `salary_max` | Upper salary bound. Null when the employer hides the salary. |
| `salary_currency` | Salary currency code. |
| `salary_period` | year or month. |
| `salary_text` | Salary as shown on CutShort, for example "12L - 18L / yr" or "Best in industry". |
| `experience` | Experience requirement text. |
| `experience_min_years` | Minimum years of experience. |
| `experience_max_years` | Maximum years of experience. |
| `skills` | Skill tags of the job. |
| `posted_at_datetime` | Posting date (ISO 8601, UTC) as CutShort shows it. CutShort renews this date when the employer re-activates a job. |
| `posted_at_text` | Posting date label as shown on CutShort. |
| `first_posted_at` | Original creation date (ISO 8601, UTC) from the job structured data. Only with includeJobDetails. |
| `expires_at` | Date until which the posting is valid (ISO 8601, UTC). Only with includeJobDetails. |
| `apply_url` | Where to apply: the job page on CutShort (applying needs a CutShort login). |
| `direct_apply` | directApply flag from the job structured data. Only with includeJobDetails. |
| `description_snippet` | First 300 characters of the description. |
| `description_html` | Full job description as HTML. Only with includeJobDetails. |
| `description_md` | Full job description as Markdown. Only with includeJobDetails. |
| `search_query` | Keyword or start URL that produced the row. |
| `scraped_at` | When the row was scraped (ISO 8601, UTC). |

Fields that need the job page (`includeJobDetails`) are `null` when it is off. Arrays are always arrays (`[]` when empty). Absent values are `null`, never an empty string.

Sample row (without job details):

```json
{
  "id": "6ad718a53d4d6fb78dd7569e",
  "title": "Lead Fullstack Developer (AI Systems & Architecture)",
  "job_url": "https://cutshort.io/job/Lead-Fullstack-Developer-AI-Systems-Architecture-Obbian-Technologies-OPC-Private-Limited-TXKudjW3",

  "company_website": null,
  "company_size": null,

  "recruiter_name": "[removed]",

    "NextJs (Next.js)",
    "Nest.js",

```

Salaries are in rupees per year. About 7 in 100 jobs have no numeric salary because the employer hides it. The text then reads "Best in industry". Remote-only jobs have no city.

You are responsible for using the data lawfully, including data-protection and marketing rules that apply to you.

## Pricing

This Actor uses pay-per-event pricing.

PRICE_LINE_TODO

| Event | When it fires |
|---|---|
| `apify-actor-start` | Once per run, charged by Apify at the start |
| `job-serp-result` | One job row from a skill page |
| `job-detail-result` | One job row enriched from its job page (`includeJobDetails`). It is charged instead of `job-serp-result` for that row |

Duplicates are never charged. Set a maximum total charge on the run to stop at a budget: the run ends cleanly when it is reached, and the status message says how many jobs were delivered. The pricing box on the Actor page always shows the current rates.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this Actor to any MCP-compatible AI client through the Apify MCP server:

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/cutshort-scraper
```

Example prompt once connected: "Use cutshort-scraper to find the newest Golang jobs in Pune posted in the last 7 days."

## FAQ

**Why does a keyword return nothing?**
CutShort groups jobs by skill. Use skill names such as `python`, `reactjs`, `data engineering` or `devops`. Long job titles rarely match a skill page. The run status lists keywords that have no skill page.

**How many jobs can one search return?**
A skill page lists up to 50 jobs, and each of the 14 big cities has its own page with 50 more. Without a city the Actor reads the city pages as well when you ask for more than 50.

**Why are some fields empty?**
List fields come from the skill page. The full description, expiry date, postal code and company size, type, stage, founding year and website come from the job page, so turn on `includeJobDetails` to get them. If one job page cannot be read, the row is still delivered with the list fields and charged as a search result.

**What happens when CutShort blocks the run?**
The Actor retries each page up to three times on a new connection. If every page is blocked, the run ends as failed with a clear status message and no job is charged. Run it again later.
